security_overrides.security/overrides.txt: Overrides stale NLTK, Protobuf, datasets and fsspec caps in framework metadata with patched releases.
security_overrides.security/lighteval-overrides.txt: Also overrides historical LightEval torch/spaCy caps for the validated tensor and NumPy 2 stack.

unpatched_dependencies_removed.diskcache: Removed unused direct DiskCache and standalone Outlines environment exports. Updated vLLM uses outlines-core without bringing back the vulnerable DiskCache package.
unpatched_dependencies_removed.sqlitedict: Replaced its only runtime use with a standard-library SQLite cache using data-only JSON. Existing pickle tables are retained but never loaded.
unpatched_dependencies_removed.sglang: Excluded from the two default reference environments because even SGLang 0.5.22 pulls Outlines and vulnerable DiskCache. Optional SGLang adapters require a separate environment; Hugging Face and vLLM adapters remain available.

unused_environment_exports_removed: manual NVIDIA CUDA library pins (the selected PyTorch wheel supplies its runtime)
outlines (updated vLLM depends on outlines-core, not this unused SDK)

validation.platform: Linux x86_64 (glibc >= 2.28), Python 3.11 dependency resolution; macOS Python 3.12 CPU smoke tests
validation.current_mla: Tiny patched Llama forward/backward and safe tensor deserialization; NLTK primitives and resource-path enforcement; JSON cache regression tests
validation.source_pinned_dependencies: Nanotron and archived LightEval retain immutable Git commit references; package-version vulnerability services cannot audit those source commits as releases.

note: This record describes the validated update scope; it is not a guarantee against future vulnerabilities.
